title: Mental math
targetPerformance: Answer at least 18 of 20 mixed multiplication, percentage, and square prompts correctly in 8 minutes without a calculator, then give a Fermi estimate with explicit units and assumptions.
whyItMatters: Make everyday calculations fast enough to check decisions on the spot.

subskills.title: Multiply by eleven
subskills.why: Use place value and carries for fast exact products.
subskills.selfCorrection: Compare with ten times the number plus one more copy.

subskills.title: Multiply by five and twenty-five
subskills.why: Replace multiplication with easy division after scaling.
subskills.selfCorrection: Check x5 by halving x10 and x25 by quartering x100.
drills: Quarter a scaled value for x25.

subskills.title: Compute percentages and changes
subskills.why: Connect common rates to useful fractions.
subskills.selfCorrection: State the base amount and distinguish percent change from percentage points.
drills: Divide a change by its original value.

subskills.title: Multiply near round numbers
subskills.why: Use x9 and near-round products with a correction.
subskills.selfCorrection: Check whether the correction must be added or subtracted.
drills: Replace x9 with x10 minus one copy.
Replace x99 with x100 minus one copy.

subskills.title: Square numbers ending in five
subskills.why: Turn a family of squares into one small multiplication.
subskills.selfCorrection: For 10a+5, multiply a by a+1, then append 25.
drills: Check the result lies between neighboring tens squared.

subskills.title: Square near fifty and one hundred
subskills.why: Use the cross term instead of dropping it.
subskills.selfCorrection: Expand (b+d)^2 as b²+2bd+d² and check the sign of d.

subskills.title: Estimate and check scale
subskills.why: Choose useful rounding and preserve units.
subskills.selfCorrection: Compare your estimate with simple upper and lower bounds.
drills: Round factors to one significant figure.
Estimate a percentage with compatible numbers.
Explain whether rounding biases upward or downward.

subskills.title: Build Fermi estimates
subskills.why: Decompose a fuzzy question into measurable factors.
subskills.selfCorrection: Write units at each step, state uncertainty, and test a factor-of-two change.
drills: State a low and high scenario.

barriers.fix: Set a 60-second mental attempt before checking.
Write the decomposition and retry with a nearby number.
Keep short rounds and record the trick that fixed a miss.
